title: Givaudan joins Global Fragrance Summit 2027 as Gold Sponsor
summary: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) is pleased to welcome Givaudan, a member of IFRA , as a Gold Sponsor of Global Fragrance Summit 2027 in Mumbai.

title: IFRA contributes to Colombian cosmetic safety course
summary: Participants from industry, academia and regulatory authorities joined an IFRA session on the IFRA Standards and risk-based fragrance safety.

title: Fragrance safety in focus: IFRA joins the SAAFFI Western Cape Seminar 2026
summary: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) will share the latest on the 52 nd Amendment to the IFRA Standards with the South African flavor and fragrance community at the seminar of the South African Association of the Flavour & Fragrance Industry ( SAAFFI ) on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 .

title: IFF joins Global Fragrance Summit 2027 as Gold Sponsor
summary: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) is pleased to welcome IFF , a founding member of IFRA , as a Gold Sponsor of Global Fragrance Summit 2027 in Mumbai.

title: Ultra International joins Global Fragrance Summit 2027 as Gold Sponsor
summary: The International Fragrance Association ( IFRA ) is pleased to welcome Ultra International, a member of IFRA from India, as a Gold Sponsor of Global Fragrance Summit 2027 in Mumbai.
